title: Gema Meulalui Tebing .
intro: Bayangkan saboh glé dipat teumpat tinggai nyang ka jikoh nibak tebing-tebing, dan udara jiba ingatan keuhai saboh peuingat nyang hana jitem deungoe. Saboh bansa njang ka tom meu-ulang-ulang disinoë, meu-ulang-ulang meu-ulang-ulang, sampoë saboh tanda teuka nibak batèë njang that-that djipeucaya lé awaknjan.
clues: Kamoe nakeuh saboh bansa nyang meu-ukheue rumoh-rumoh nyang aman nibak gunong-gunong, meurasa aman lam teumpat tinggai kamoe nyang meubatèe-batèe.
Kamoe tinggai di nanggroe nyang meuasoe dataran dan batée-batée, nyang geubri beureukat deungon taman-taman dan mata ié.
Sidroe utosan nibak lamkawan kamoe teuka, geutawök kamoe mangat kamoe tinggai dewa-dewa palsu kamoe dan kamoe seumah sidroe Pencipta nyang beutôi.
Tanyoe deungon sombong tapeugot saboh syarat keu keuyakinan: saboh tanda nyang unik nyang akan teuka nibak batee-batee nyang that tanyoe ukheue.
Watèë unta inong njang ka djidjak janji njan deuh nibak batèë, saboh tanda njang djeulaih, elit geutanjoë mantong djitulak dan djipeu-atô djih bah that pih na peuingat keu azab njang akan teuka.
Lhee uroe lheuh buet kamoe, saboh ledakan geulanteue meu-gema lam glé, dan kamoe ka meu-ulang-ulang jeuet keu putoh-putoh nyang ka rhet, rumoh kamoe jeuet keu kubu kamoe.

outcome.label: Hase geutanyoe
options: Keuhancuran le saboh beureutoh nyang peu-peu-peu .
Saboh ié raya nyang jitôb bumoe .
Saboh angen nyang teuga nyang jipeu-ukheue geutanyoe .
outcome.answer: Keuhancuran le saboh beureutoh nyang peu-peu-peu .

arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَىٰ ثَمُودَ أَخَاهُمْ صَـٰلِحًا أَنِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ فَإِذَا هُمْ فَرِيقَانِ يَخْتَصِمُونَ
verse: And We had certainly sent to Thamūd their brother Ṣāliḥ, [saying], "Worship Allāh," and at once they were two parties conflicting. (27:45)
